text:
No option can be put forward because the churn requirement was not assessed in this run.

- The model compared £49, £54 and £59/month and describes the comparison as robust under its tested changes, but that does not establish compliance with monthly churn under 4%.
- The churn limit could not be aligned with the model’s calculated churn measure; its frame is unknown, so goal-fit probabilities were withheld rather than guessed.
- The comparison is most structurally sensitive to the Pro subscriber base—an Olumi estimate, with low attribution stability—not a recorded measurement.
